name: Vectorize
summary: Vectorize is Cloudflare's globally distributed vector database for Workers. It stores embeddings generated with Workers AI or another provider and answers similarity queries, and results can point back to objects in R2, KV or D1. Cloudflare's agent docs use it as a vector store and as a custom search provider for agent memory.
facts: Up to 20M vectors per index (Workers Paid)
$0.01 per 1M queried dimensions, $0.05 per 100M stored, after inclusions
watchOut: Lower level than AI Search: you create and upsert embeddings yourself
